speak.title: Role-play: the new AI tool
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: Next month your team must start using a new AI tool. It will save time and money. Explain why it is a good idea. Ask your employee how they feel. Try to find a plan you both accept.

b.text: You love the creative part of your job, and the new AI tool will do most of it. You are worried. Say how you feel, ask to keep some of the work, and say what you might do if nothing changes.

phrases: I'd like to talk about the new tool.
It's going to save us a lot of time.
I'm worried it'll take the best part of my job.
Couldn't I keep some of the work myself?
I'd hate to leave, but I might have to.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did you find a plan, or did the employee decide to leave?
